$comment: BASE permissions for an avengers-12 implement run. Not used directly:
avengers-12/lib/emit-settings.sh merges this with config.yml and writes
.loop/settings-implement.json, which is what the workflow passes to
anthropics/claude-code-action.
Everything here is about the HARNESS, not about your project, which is why
it is the same for everyone and lives in a file you do not edit:
1. Publishing   - the agent commits locally; bash decides what gets pushed
2. Network      - no curl, no wget, no gh
3. The safe allow list - read-only git, plus the evidence script
Everything project-specific is DERIVED from config.yml instead:
Write(p) and Edit(p)  for every path in gate.deny
Read(p)               for every path in permissions.denyRead
Bash(c)               for every command in permissions.allowBash
Those used to be typed in here by hand, mirroring gate.deny, with a comment
asking you to remember to keep the two in step. One list cannot drift from
itself, so now there is one list.
These rules are prefix matches, so treat them as defence in depth, never as
the only line. `git -C . push` does not match `Bash(git push:*)`. The real
enforcement is avengers-12/lib/check-gate.sh, which inspects the diff after
the agent has finished and before anything is pushed.
